page0.text:
We go out into the yard.
The entire world is cloaked in shadow.
My entire body shivers with mind-numbing awe and fear, down to my fingertips.

page1.text:
...The black Shadow is before us.
If it wanted to, it could crush us along with the entire house.
The difference in power is clear.
It's transformed into a state unlike anything we've seen.

page2.text:
"..."
...That Shadow does nothing.
It isn't Sakura, but the Shadow shaped like her.
The real Sakura is underground, beneath Ryudou Temple.
The thing quivering in front of us is a false image modeled after her.

page3.text:
"...Hmph. Couldn't even bother to come in person, huh? You've gotten a big head in the short time we haven't seen you, Sakura."
"..."
I'm not sure if it isn't hearing Tohsaka's taunts, or if it can't hear our words at all.
Sakura's shadow sways in the moonlight. It looks terribly lonely.

page4.text:
"..."
Its eyes are definitely looking at me.
"Senpai," it says.
It looks so meek, that it might actually respond like Sakura always does if I hold out my hand.

page5.text:
...
But I don't.
I know what I have to do.
I can't call out to Sakura and risk weakening my resolve.

page6.text:
I look away.
Sakura's shadow seems hurt.
"Did you hear everything from Illyasviel, Nee-san?"
The Shadow faces Tohsaka, speaking in a cold, scornful tone.

page7.text:
"I did. We know what's possessing you, and the abilities of the thing about to be born from the Holy Grail.
So, Sakura, let me ask you this: Do you plan to cut your ties with Aŋra Mainiiu?"
Tohsaka's voice sounds the same.
Her voice is cool, condescending, and thoroughly unimpressed.

page8.text:
"No. I said the weak me is gone now, remember? I suffered so much for this power. I don't want to leave it, nor can I.
...This is the only way for me to live."

page9.text:
"Okay. One more question.
How's your precious Servant coming along? Illya said it should be almost ready, but how do you feel as a mother? Is it outside already?"

page10.text:
"...Of course not. If that thing comes out, it'll devour the entire town in a flash.
I won't let that happen. Senpai is still here.
So, as long as I'm here, I won't let that child out."

page11.text:
"Oh. So we don't need to rush. As long as Shirou is with me, you'll keep Aŋra Mainiiu in check.
Isn't that nice, Shirou? Sakura's still doing just fine."

page12.text:
"...Stop messing around. You know I can't hold on much longer, don't you?
You need to take Senpai and run. I don't have much time left. I don't know when I might disappear. Tonight might be the last night I stay myself."

page13.text:
"That's why I'm here to warn you.
...Nee-san, take Senpai and run somewhere far away. If you can do that, then I feel safe taking the child down with me."

page14.text:
Sakura said she'd take it down with her.
Tohsaka's shoulders tremble slightly.
Does she believe Sakura, or...

page15.text:
"...Hmph. You say you don't know when you'll disappear.
You're mistaking that for not knowing when you won't be able to hold back, Sakura."
"Nee-san..."

page16.text:
"Fine, whatever. I don't know how you plan to take Aŋra Mainiiu down with you, but you'll be free to kill yourself if Shirou and I leave, right?
You'll die for us, along with the Servants in the Holy Grail, whose power you've inherited."

page17.text:
"...Y-yes. So please run.
I... I don't want you to see me change. I'll be okay as long as Senpai... as long as Senpai goes away.
So please don't chase after me anymore."

page18.text:
She makes a determined plea.
Sakura's shadow could kill me at any second, but she's earnestly asking me not to chase after her.

page19.text:
...
I can't honor that wish.
I refuse to leave her and run, and I won't let her kill herself either.
And so...
"We're going over there. We're coming to kill you."
Tohsaka severs ties with her blood sister.

page20.text:
"Wha..."
"Makes sense, doesn't it? As the Tohsaka mage, I can't let you be. I also don't trust you to kill yourself.
Have you noticed how you don't make any sense, Sakura? You're telling me to run, even though you want to kill me.
Honestly, you're such a goody-two-shoes in front of Shirou."

page21.text:
"What...did you say..."
"Now that's a nice face. You should've worn that from the beginning.
Is that all you came to say? Then get out of here. Take your time; we're coming for you soon.
Listen, Sakura. I'll be the one to kill you, and no one else."

page22.text:
Tohsaka declares in a gentle voice.
...The shadow quivers.
For a moment, Sakura's projection freezes like a statue.
"Yes... I'll be waiting for you, Nee-san."
She lets out a lurid giggle and disappears.

page23.text:
The shadows covering the house are gone.
Only Tohsaka and I are left standing in the yard.

page24.text:
I feel dizzy.
I meant to keep my focus, but seeing Sakura apparently shook me.
...It seems that Sakura isn't the only one running out of time.

page25.text:
"...Shirou.
You heard Sakura. What about you?
I won't stop you if you want to leave town. I'll be taking the Jeweled Sword first, though."

page26.text:
"You don't need to ask. I'm going to keep fighting, and I'll Project that sword for you.
We're working together, remember? I'll back you up when there's anything you can't do."

page27.text:
"...Okay, that's fine. Do you get it, though, Shirou?
Going with me means killing Sakura. That goes for the Jeweled Sword, too. You need to provide me with a weapon to kill her."

page28.text: "...Yeah. I'm definitely contradicting myself by making the Jeweled Sword. But we can't beat Sakura right now, and I already promised that I'd make it. If you need me to Project the Jeweled Sword to fight Sakura's Shadow, then it has to be done."

page29.text:
"Huh... So, you're..."
"Yeah, I'm the opposite of you. I'm going to save Sakura and end this war. I promised that I'd be her hero."

page30.text:
"Even though letting Sakura live means you're going to kill everyone else?"
"That isn't set in stone yet. There should be a way to help Sakura without causing any more deaths."

page31.text:
"...I'm not so sure. Sakura's already killed many people. Is saving someone like that still what you'd call being a hero, Shirou?"
She alludes to something critical.
It's an inescapable sin.
Her words drive into my chest, and I finally say...

page32.text:
"...Yeah. I'll protect Sakura, even if she stops being human. I'll protect her from everything, including the version of her that wants to kill herself.
That's all I want to do. That's what it means to be on her side."
I proudly voice my feelings.

page33.text:
"...Haah. You're so shameless."
I nod, shamelessly.

page34.text:
"...Okay. I didn't think you'd listen to me, but you're this stubborn? Honestly, I give up."
"Huh? Where are you going, Tohsaka?"

page35.text:
"I need to get ready to fight, obviously.
Sakura warned us because she really is at her wit's end. We need to hurry."
"W-well, yeah, but we're not done talk—"

page36.text:
"The conversation's over. You said that you'll protect Sakura as long as you live.
...Hmph. Fine, I won't say anything about it anymore. Go struggle as much as you want."

page37.text:
"Hm...?"
Where did all her tension go? Tohsaka seems to be pouting, strangely enough.

page38.text:
"But don't get the wrong idea. This is our deal to have you make the Jeweled Sword.
As long as you keep trying, I'll let you decide how to deal with Sakura. I won't step in until you can't move anymore.
...No complaints there, right? You might be able to save her if you work hard enough."

page39.text:
With that parting remark, Tohsaka goes off to the guesthouse.
"..."
As I watch her leave, a big part of the anxiety gripping my chest seems to melt away.
We're thinking in opposite directions.
But Tohsaka still wants to help Sakura.
